capabilities: classify uncategorized articles from source directories
extract source-backed knowledge into Wiki sections
update Wiki index, source mappings and logs
review low-quality sources with cleanup or keep actions
build a Canvas knowledge map from Wiki content
extras: Proprietary license despite visible source code; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Author warns to test on a copy of the vault since classification changes file paths and model judgments can be wrong. Default source paths are Chinese reading directories (Xiaohongshu, WeChat official accounts). No telemetry; API key stored unencrypted in the vault's plugin data.json.
problem: Reading notes pile up as unclassified raw files; Obsidian has no workflow to turn them into an organized, source-backed Wiki with quality review.
